description: This file defines the IAVInput interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including related nested structures, enumerations, notification interfaces, and method declarations for managing AV input devices, signals, EDID information, and associated event notifications in a multimedia or device control context.

classes.name: IAVInput
classes.description: The IAVInput interface provides methods and event notifications for managing AV input devices, configurations, status, and related features such as EDID handling, signal changes, and game feature support.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the device with the provided service.

methods.name: RegisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers for notifications when input devices change.

methods.name: UnregisterDevicesChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters devices change notifications.

methods.name: RegisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers for signal change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterSignalChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters signal change notifications.

methods.name: RegisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Registers for input status change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterInputStatusChangedNotification
methods.description: Unregisters input status change notifications.

methods.name: RegisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers for video stream info update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterVideoStreamInfoUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters video stream info update notifications.

methods.name: RegisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers for game feature status update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterGameFeatureStatusUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters game feature status update notifications.

methods.name: RegisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Registers for AV content type update notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterAviContentTypeUpdateNotification
methods.description: Unregisters AV content type update notifications.

methods.name: NumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of available input devices and success status.

methods.name: WriteEDID
methods.description: Writes a new EDID value to a specified input device.

methods.name: ReadEDID
methods.description: Reads the current EDID value from a specified input device.

methods.name: GetRawSPD
methods.description: Retrieves the raw SPD infoFrame packet for a specified HDMI input.

methods.name: GetSPD
methods.description: Retrieves the SPD infoFrame packet for a specified HDMI input.

methods.name: SetEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a specified port.

methods.name: GetEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the EDID version for a specified port.

methods.name: SetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets the Allm support bit in EDID for a specified port.

methods.name: GetEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the Allm support bit from EDID.

methods.name: SetVRRSupport
methods.description: Sets the VRR support bit in EDID for a specified port.

methods.name: GetVRRSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the VRR support bit from EDID.

methods.name: GetHdmiVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum HDMI compatibility version supported by a port.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets the audio mixer levels.

methods.name: StartInput
methods.description: Activates a specific input port as the primary source.

methods.name: StopInput
methods.description: Deactivates the current input port.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions for an input.

methods.name: CurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Returns the current video mode for the input device.

methods.name: ContentProtected
methods.description: Indicates whether the content is protected.

methods.name: GetSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Returns a list of supported game features.

methods.name: GetGameFeatureStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific game feature.

methods.name: GetVRRFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current VRR frame rate.
